_purpose: Constitution registry — pins the SHA-256 of the canonical INVENTION_PROTOCOL_V<N>.md file. Preflight checks this pin on every run; a mismatch (file modified without V<N+1> supersession) is a hard CI failure.
_authority: INVENTION_PROTOCOL_V1 §14 (Protocol Evolution Workflow) and §3.8 (Protocol Immutability Within a Run)
_immutability: This file MAY be edited only via the Protocol Evolution Workflow (Section 14). An edit outside that workflow is itself a governance violation.

supersession_history.audit_notes: Initial constitution. Canonical path moved from repo root to protocol/INVENTION_PROTOCOL_V1.md on 2026-08-17 to align with the protocol/ directory convention; this is a path-only correction (no content change), so V1 hash remains authoritative and no V2 was created. The path correction itself is recorded in protocol/CHANGELOG.md.

constitutional_invariants: Non-compensable status of Patent and Evidence gates (Protocol §7.2)

preflight_must_verify: Canonical constitution file exists at current_canonical_path
SHA-256 of the file at current_canonical_path equals current_sha256
Every invention folder's 00_MANIFEST.json references current_version (no orphan inventions on a superseded protocol)
Every invention folder's 21_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.json references current_version in its 'protocol' field
ci_enforcement.on_mismatch: preflight_check.py exits 1 (blocks commit) and writes the specific mismatch to preflight_report.json
ci_enforcement.on_missing_constitution: preflight_check.py exits 1 with section 'X.0' check 'constitution_canonical_present' = false
